editorial.blurb: House of Pho delivers generous bowls of Vietnamese comfort, with a rich, flavorful broth and fresh ingredients that shine when the kitchen is on point.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask them to pack your noodles and broth separately if you're taking leftovers—reviewers praised this thoughtful packing method.
